prompt:
Style: hand-drawn children's picture-book illustration in the Sammakko style. Soft colored-pencil and wax-crayon texture inside the shapes, with visible grainy strokes. Bold, smooth, rounded dark navy-blue outline (#244868-like) of even weight around every shape. Simple friendly faces: round black eyes with one small white highlight, small pink blush on the cheeks. Bright but gentle colors, flat even lighting, no hard shadows, no gradients, no 3D render look, no photorealism. Clean silhouette that reads well at small size (128-256 px). No text, no letters, no watermark, no frame.

Wide landscape background illustration: a calm pond at night with a big round moon, stars and soft blue tones. The Sammakko world: calm water, soft green land and small islands. Keep the upper third calm and simple so text or game elements can be placed there. No characters unless mentioned, no text.
